IsAutoActive.description: Automatic climate: the HVAC ECU drives fan speed. Custom signal (not in COVESA VSS).

IsSyncActive.description: Passenger and rear zones follow the driver temperature. Custom signal (not in COVESA VSS).

IsRearControlLocked.description: Rear passengers cannot change the rear zone. Custom signal (not in COVESA VSS).

PedalPosition.description: Brake pedal travel. 0 = released, 100 = fully pressed.

IsEngaged.description: Parking brake status. True = Parking Brake is Engaged.

CurrentPower.description: Current electrical energy flowing in/out of battery. Positive = Energy flowing in to battery, e.g. during charging. Negative = Energy flowing out of battery, e.g. during driving.

IsPowerConnected.description: Indicating if the high voltage battery is connected (contactors closed).

Range.description: Remaining range in meters using all energy sources available in the vehicle.

IsOpen.description: Is trunk open or closed. True = Open. False = Closed.

IsSignaling.description: Indicates if light is signaling or off.

IsOn.description: Indicates if light is on or off.

Keyless.description: Custom (not in COVESA VSS). Passive entry / passive start.

KeyLocation.description: Custom (not in COVESA VSS). Where the key (fob or phone key) is detected.

Distance.description: Distance in meters to detected object. 250 = nothing in range.

IsWarning.description: Indicates if a forward collision warning is active.

IsEnabled.description: Custom (not in COVESA VSS). Lane keeping assist switch.

LateralOffset.description: Custom (not in COVESA VSS). Ego offset from the lane center. Positive = right of center.

Curvature.description: Custom (not in COVESA VSS). Lane curvature ahead. Positive = curving right.

LaneKeepingAssist.description: Custom (not in COVESA VSS). Lane keeping assist and lane geometry from the front camera.

IsEngaged.description: Indicates if ESC is currently regulating vehicle stability. True = Engaged.

SpeedLimiter.description: Custom (not in COVESA VSS). Driver-set speed limiter.

IsActive.description: Indicates if cruise control system is active (i.e. actively controls speed). True = Active. False = Inactive.

SpeedSet.description: Set cruise control speed in kilometers per hour.

AdaptiveIntervalSet.description: Set cruise control time interval (gap) in seconds.

LaneDepartureDetection.description: Signals from Lane Departure Detection System.

IsWarning.description: Indicates if lane departure detection registered a lane departure.

TrafficSignRecognition.description: Custom (not in COVESA VSS). Traffic sign recognition.

SpeedLimit.description: Custom (not in COVESA VSS). Current speed limit from signs or map. 0 = unknown.

LowVoltageSystemState.description: State of the supply voltage of the control units (usually 12V).

TraveledDistance.description: Odometer reading, total distance traveled during the lifetime of the vehicle.

TripMeterReading.description: Trip meter reading. The driver can reset it.

LowVoltageBattery.description: Signals related to low voltage battery.

CurrentVoltage.description: Current voltage of the low voltage battery.

PowerMode.description: Custom (not in COVESA VSS). Driver power requests (start button / power off).

Request.description: Custom (not in COVESA VSS). Requested power mode. READY closes the high-voltage contactors.
